folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B313: all opening details, actual hooks and later direction
folds.body:
All450 original lines were content-reviewed: MD1–MD144 across24 SA kinds, MD145–MD198 across nine entry kinds, MD199–MD214's sixteen causal tells, MD215–MD234's twenty ranked placements, the cost legend, memory-coherence note and limits. Preserve the optional palette and its original words. Two or three compatible details is a proposal for an opening, not a quota or a234-feature execution queue. Role and entry are separate axes; no216-case Cartesian test requirement follows.

T/D classifies the detail's incremental copy cost only after its compatible start and real text surface exist. A static receipt, key or pot in scenery is not an inventory grant or executable affordance. Making it usable needs actual identity, ownership, discovery, action and custody consumers. Shared template flavor cannot assert a particular object's lived history. H rows correctly name additional state/trigger/presentation work; a table label does not implement it. Body habits need the admitted retention premise, and ordinary texture does not grant an inaccessible autobiography, a teacher's confidence or private counterpart history.

MD199–MD214 are useful because a tell can expose actual changed logistics, a substitute's means, a committed branch change or a transferred obligation. Render them from observer-entitled evidence. A canceled event leaves residue only where that preparation really happened; an unknown event cannot leak through empty racks or an unexplained precise timing cue merely because the backend knows it. A frozen branch does not accumulate dust, debt or social change unless its actual clock/policy advances. A fresh instance does not inherit a continued branch's latch repair, purchases or the character's memories. Endings should record actual witnessed consequences and custody, without inventing achievements, rescue or successors to soften loss.

MD215–MD234 retain useful specific coherence repairs: extra money is additive rather than total, packed bread is additional stock, and a body mark need not imply remembered parent/home/flight when the entry omits that memory. Waking or arrival amnesia does not itself require erasing every earlier skill or life memory. The actual retained-memory contract decides whether those sentences conflict. Do not automatically strip a supported partial-memory opening to make one example fit. The known/unknown probe presentation concerns author/player selection; it does not establish the character's diegetic knowledge or authorize revealing latent causes.

The old main/probe source paths, localization keys, initial102coins/fivebread/quality40 and additive patch values are dated inspections. Later intro history records a merged725-test developer probe, qualifying this file's isolated/unmerged snapshot without proving every ordinary start or the current text slot. Its1366primary/1440 comparison targets are superseded by the current UI owner. The later directPLAY restoration also means the proposed start card is not selected launch work. Current testbed direction qualifies the old ranking of ten new Village-copy refinements; preserve them as ideas rather than broaden current scope.

A useful selected detail can be tiny and reversible. It still needs correct ordinary/exceptional body senses, actual known time and observed actor state. No cue requires a new signal registry, room art, audio, visual effect, extra panel or autosave change. This review changes no player-facing copy, source fact, resolved beginning, save or runtime, and performs no fresh source, browser, memory-provenance or gameplay test.
